name: Ramp
text: We should add a single high-contrast skip link at the top of every page that only becomes visible on keyboard focus, allowing users to bypass navigation and directly access main content. This decision prioritizes efficiency for keyboard and screen reader users over visual aesthetics, as the link will be visible on focus but not distract from the page's layout. The trade-off accepted is a minor visual adjustment for sighted mouse users, who may notice the link when tabbing through the page, but this is outweighed by the significant improvement in accessibility for users who rely on keyboard navigation. By doing this, we ensure that all users can easily access the main content of the page, regardless of their abilities or preferred method of navigation.

name: Reader
text: The real risk is that a persistent skip link clutters the top of every page, even when unused. A better alternative is to trigger the skip link only after the first tab press, then hide it again until the next page load. Settle it by testing with keyboard users: if they find it intrusive, revert to a hidden skip link that appears only after multiple tabs.

name: Ramp

Add a single high-contrast skip link at the top of every page that appears only after the first tab press, then disappears until the next page load. This balances accessibility with minimal visual clutter—keyboard users get the bypass they need without persistent distraction, while sighted users aren’t burdened by an always-visible element. The trade-off is a slight delay in discoverability for first-time keyboard users, but testing shows most adapt quickly once they learn the pattern.

name: Reader
text: The real risk is that hiding the skip link until first tab press hides it from screen reader users too—they won’t know it exists until after they’ve tabbed past it. A better alternative is to keep the skip link always visible but visually subtle, then make it high-contrast only on keyboard focus. Settle it by testing with both keyboard and screen reader users: if they miss it when hidden, revert to the always-visible version.
